_openFirestoreWrites_reason: FOLLOW-UP: legacy anonymous flows still written by the client SDK — Q.Vote self-registration (candidates), Q.Hunt legacy lib, analytics logs, gamification/packs. Move each behind an API route + Admin SDK, then remove it from this list.
_openRtdbWrites_reason: Q.Games peer-to-peer state written by anonymous players (no Firebase auth). Leaderboard/records are server-only. FOLLOW-UP: anonymous auth + per-player validation.
